messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — we're planning a semver-major change that will remove the old `X-Redwood-Key` header and require `Authorization: Redwood <token>` across SDKs. Need coordination with marketplace vendors, HW partners, and SIs. Proposing an 8-week deprecation runway + partner portal notice.

josh: +1 on the timeline. Do we have a compatibility matrix for hardware partners who embed older SDKs? Some vendors ship locked images.

ali: Working on matrix now. Two asks: (1) can eng provide a minimal shim that vendors can drop into their firmware images, (2) legal/marketing approval for a joint announcement template.

emma: We can do a tiny header-translation shim. Example (node):

```js
// translate X-Redwood-Key -> Authorization
const header = req.headers['x-redwood-key'];
if (header && !req.headers['authorization']) {
  req.headers['authorization'] = `Redwood ${header}`;
}
next();
```

It'll be a small npm package and a single-file C shim for constrained devices. ETA: 7 business days for both.

parth: For SI partners we should include an ops playbook: feature flags for rolling traffic, canary config, and a troubleshooting checklist (401/403 mapping, edge cache invalidation). I can draft.

kate: Legal reviewed the basic dep notice language last week. We can sign off on partner-facing wording, but marketing needs the dates to sync the Marketplace banner and PA.

maria: Good — owners: Emma (shim + release), Ali (partner matrix + outreach), Parth (SI playbook), Josh (marketplace listing flow + gating), Kate (legal + marketing sync). I'll own the partner portal notice draft.

partner-bot: Reminder — submit partner portal draft at least 10 business days before public notice to allow translations and vendor sign-off.

josh: Marketplace note: we need to add a compatibility flag per listing (legacy-sdk-safe: true/false). If false, show an inline migration guide link and schedule for removal. I can change the schema but need a PR by EOD Thursday.

ali: We're going to categorize vendors into 3 buckets: (A) auto-upgradable images, (B) manual firmware updates, (C) locked/legacy. For (C) we'll offer a hosted shim gateway option for 6 months.

maria: Sounds like a plan. Action items recap:
- Emma: publish shims (npm + C) and example Docker image (7bd).
- Ali: full partner impact matrix + vendor outreach list (3bd).
- Parth: SI ops playbook + migration checklist (5bd).
- Josh: marketplace schema PR + UI copy for compatibility flag (EOD Thu).
- Kate: finalize legal/marketing partner-facing language (4bd).
- Maria: draft partner portal notice + announcement timeline (2bd).

Please add your blockers here. If none, I'll send the first outreach batch Monday. :rocket:

emma: no blockers, will start shim repo and open a draft PR today.

ali: ping me when PR is up, I'll start filling vendor buckets from last quarter's list.

parth: will prototype the playbook on the internal runbook template and share.

josh: starting schema PR now. tagging @marketplace-team for visibility.

maria: thanks everyone — I'll post the draft partner notice in #partnerships-drafts once ready.
